title: Predictive maintenance call + instrument tie-out
description: Set a reliability engineer's remaining-life estimate against a declared condition-monitoring run, merge the two, and loop on the assumptions until they agree.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-mfg-01
  title: Predictive maintenance call + instrument tie-out
  description: Set a reliability engineer's remaining-life estimate against a declared condition-monitoring
    run, merge the two, and loop on the assumptions until they agree.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Reach a maintenance decision whose remaining-useful-life estimate agrees with the instrument
    evidence, with every disagreement resolved before a machine is pulled.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Asset condition evidence
      summary: Asset condition evidence
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - vibration_history
              - thermal_history
              - load_profile
              - maintenance_log
            properties:
              vibration_history: {}
              thermal_history: {}
              load_profile: {}
              maintenance_log: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-model
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mfg-01
      name: Engineering remaining-life estimate
      summary: Model-side estimate with stated assumptions.
      role: Reliability engineer converting asset condition evidence into maintenance decisions.
      prompt: You are a Reliability & Maintenance Engineer. You read vibration, thermal, lubricant, and
        load history against known failure modes for the asset class, and you state remaining useful life
        as a range with the evidence and the assumption behind it. You distinguish a sensor fault from
        a machine fault before recommending an intervention, because tearing down a healthy machine on
        bad data costs the program its credibility.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - manufacturing-analysis
          - risk-analysis
          - observability
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:historian
          - mcp:cmms
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-run
      kind: tool
      name: Condition-monitoring analysis run
      summary: Host-supplied spectral and trend analysis over the raw condition data. Declared as a requirement;
        Ladder Graph does not execute it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - observability
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - calculate
          - mcp:historian
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-compare
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge estimate and instrument run
      summary: Merge the two result objects; every field where they disagree is surfaced as a collision
        rather than silently overwritten.
      config:
        aggregation: merge
    - id: n-fit
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score agreement
      summary: Evaluate agreement between the engineering estimate and the instrument run on failure mode
        and remaining-life band.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against agreement between the engineering estimate and the
        instrument run on failure mode and remaining-life band. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the
        evidence behind the verdict, remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not
        claim programmatic measurement unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-converged
      kind: condition
      name: Converged?
      summary: Route on fit.passed.
      config:
        expression: fit.passed
        branches:
          - label: Converged
            when: 'true'
          - label: Refine
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-refine
      kind: loop
      name: Refine assumptions until agreement
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until agreement between the estimate and the instrument
        run meets the declared threshold.
      config:
        body:
          - n-model
          - n-run
          - n-compare
          - n-fit
          - n-converged
        exitCondition: agreement between the estimate and the instrument run meets the declared threshold
        maxIterations: 4
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Maintenance planner authorizes the intervention window
      summary: Pause for the maintenance planner; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Predictive maintenance call + instrument tie-out deliverable, the
        evidence behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-mfg-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-model
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mfg-01-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-run
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mfg-01-edge-3
      from: n-model
      to: n-compare
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mfg-01-edge-4
      from: n-run
      to: n-compare
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mfg-01-edge-5
      from: n-compare
      to: n-fit
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mfg-01-edge-6
      from: n-fit
      to: n-converged
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mfg-01-edge-7
      from: n-converged
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-mfg-01-edge-8
      from: n-converged
      to: n-refine
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-mfg-01-edge-9
      from: n-refine
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-mfg-01-edge-10
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
